caption: The drawing depicts two objects placed on a plain, light beige background. On the left side, there is a wooden baseball bat, rendered with a light brown color and visible wood grain texture, featuring three carved bands near the thicker end. On the right side, there is a metallic object resembling a T-shaped pipe with a cylindrical body, two horizontal handles protruding from each side, and a star-shaped cutout on one end. This object is shaded in tones of gray and brown with visible metallic highlights and shadows. The signature "John Petrucci DEL.-N.Y.A." is written in the lower right section.
title: Star Pastry Squeezer
